_comment: This is a documented placeholder, not a real .pbxproj.
The real project file is machine-generated by Xcode and lives in
FedSpa.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj when the maintainer opens this
folder in Xcode and creates the target. The build recipe is:
1. Open this ios/ folder in Xcode -> File > New > Project > iOS App
2. Name it FedSpa, bundle id ai.ninjatech.fedspa
5. Build (Cmd+B). No third-party packages: zero SPM dependencies.
CI can reproduce the project with xcodegen if ever needed; the
source tree below is what the target must reference.

sourceTree.ContentView.swift: root view, rows, details, settings sheet
sourceTree.DataManager.swift: bundled data loading, unlock state, search
